name: Ivey Business School, Western University

tuition_total.basis: School tuition table '2027', estimated; international rate shown as value; $5,000 non-refundable deposit credited to first term.

mandatory_fees_total.note: Value = mandatory items only (ancillary $2,300 + course materials $2,700). School's own total of $6,200 includes the optional $1,200 health & dental plan; international students add mandatory UHIP $820.

living_budget_total.note: Derived: 12 x (room in a student house $700 + insurance $20 + utilities $100 + food $500 + phone $80 + misc $425). School gives monthly items only, no annual total; rents are 'starting' rates. Bus pass included in tuition and fees.

scholarship.note: Approximately 80% of incoming students (domestic and international) receive an admission scholarship of $10,000 to $70,000. No average published.

base_salary.note: Only figure readable: $123,932 average total compensation (base, signing bonus and other guaranteed compensation).

employment.notes: The 'Ivey MBA 2025 Permanent Employment Report' is a FlippingBook publication (online.flippingbook.com/shelf/271812/876540/) rendered by JavaScript from signed CloudFront assets; not readable with curl/WebFetch (403 on page assets). Headline figures from the MBA home page (89% received at least one offer six months post-graduation; $123,932 average total compensation; 95% of accepters made a career transition). Industry, function, geography, base salary and 3-month rate need a browser re-read.
